text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Opposition parties return to their bases to decide whether to participate in parliamentary elections. Islamic Action Front to decide next week.

- Trade Minister Hani al-Mulqi met his Israeli counterpart on Wednesday. The two sides agreed to: - fix working times for border customs centres; - set meeting of trade descriptions and measurement officials; - set meeting of insurance officials to iron out differences in insurance policies between two countries; - post ministry representatives on both sides of the border to facilitate coordination.
- King Hussein returns from European tour, warns against losing hope in the Middle East and of an explosion of violence. Says time has come for the world to hear the voice of the supporters of peace.
- Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu urges King Hussein to intervene to save the peace process.
